comment_clean: Amazing location, spacious apartment, beautifully decorated! The only downside, it was hot! comment_clean: The apartment was located up a narrow lane close to the main road along the river. Nice restaurants, a bakery, a pharmacy, medical clinic and grocery nearby. You should know that there is a large flight of stairs to get up to it. Plus there were no instructions or information for any of the appliances or for the area. The apartment was comfortable, beds were nice. But, the attached house next door was being renovated/demolished so the noise during the day was rather annoying.
evidence: the noise during the day was rather annoying.
